integrity: The statement is a single theorem with its full counting formulas and bipartite consequences. No independence or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Paths mean ordinary simple path subgraphs, not necessarily induced paths.
The formulas apply to complete multipartite graphs with positive parts and \(4\le k\le N\).
The longest-path criterion and scalar complete-bipartite minimum-cover values are previously established.
The closely related Li–Zuo 2018 source was not available in complete full text; publication priority is provisional.
Finite direct enumeration corroborates but does not establish unrestricted validity; the proof is combinatorial.
No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Exact \(k\)-path transversal polynomials of complete multipartite graphs
